contexts.text: Lips of songs () = what is spiritual.

The Most Ancients... like the Angels, spoke by ideas, which they could express by innumerable changes... especially of the lips, in which there are innumerable series of muscular fibres which at this day are not disentangled and free... AC 1118:2. SE 530. SE 3322. (See AC 1762. AC 7745. AC 10587. AC 10588. AC 10709:end. SE 3882.)
The whole earth was of one lip () = that everywhere there was one doctrine in general. AC 1316.
That a lip = doctrine. Illustrated. AC 1288. AC 1316.
Lips () = the interiors of man, thus internal worship, from which is adoration.
Let us confound their lip () = that none had the truth of doctrine. Lip = doctrine. AC 1327.

That they may not hear a man the lip of his companion () = that they were all discordant... Not to hear the lip of a companion, is not to acknowledge what the other is saying; and, in the internal sense, not to acknowledge... his doctrine; for a lip = doctrine.
A vernal heat beginning from the region of the lips...
See Ancient Church.
As the food is softly received by the lips... SE 1742.
Uncircumcised in lips () = to be impure as to the things of doctrine.
I observed that ray lips were moved. AC 10587:2.
The bullocks of the lips ()... the goods of doctrine; for the lips = the things which are of doctrine. AE 279:3.
The calves of the Ups () = confessions from the affection of truth.
They folded their lips... TCR 111.
The Angels compressed his lips.
That Spirits not instructed suppose that they have spoken to me with the lips. Explained.
Hence the term lips, in the Word, = ideas, and thus thoughts.
Communication by the lips = ideas apprehended by a sensuous way.
The speech of the Spirits of Jupiter with me by means of the lips and gums. Explained.
Only his upper lip seen.
That the lips correspond to truths.
Lips () = the doctrine of truth. References. AE 701:9.
The lip of Canaan () = the genuine truths of the Church.
The mouth and lips of the prophet () = the doctrine of good and truth. ( = the thought and affection, or the understanding and the will. AE 580:4.)
The lips of Canaan () = the genuine doctrinal things of the Church. ( = the truths of doctrine of the Church. AE 654:7.)
I heard lips I had not known () = falsities of doctrine.
A people of depths of lip () = falsities of doctrine confirmed even to the appearance of truth. Lip = the truth of doctrine; here, falsity, because the people will not be seen.

Lip, mouth, and tongue are frequently mentioned; and by lip is signified doctrine; by mouth, thought; and by tongue, confession... The reason is that (these three) are externals of man by means of which internal things are made public.
A people deep of lip... () = those who are in a doctrine which is not intelligible...
The mischief of their lips () falsity of doctrine.
Under Mouth, see this reference.
Lips = doctrinal things.
The breath of His lips () = Divine truth, or the Word in the spiritual sense.
Lips = thought. AE 923:4.
The lips, tongue, and breath of Jehovah () = the Divine truth, which is the Word, from its ultimates to its inmosts.
